mcpServers.name: recallum
mcpServers.description: Streamable HTTP Recallum MCP. On Grok Build, register the server natively in config.toml with Bearer ${RECALLUM_API_KEY}; the plugin-bundled Claude userConfig placeholders are not resolved by Grok. Antigravity CLI also registers natively (agy plugin install writes ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json), and, unlike Grok, writes the bearer token in cleartext since Antigravity performs no ${...} expansion at all.
